goal: The agent in a Barkdown chat has a lean, stable context and a library to write in: the seven issues filed from the owner's in-app chat on 2026-10-04 (#67 to #73) are solved or rewritten against what the code and measurements say.
scope: A. Only Barkdown's servers in a run: strictMcpConfig keeps the claude.ai connectors out, which settingSources: [] never did (#67, #68, #69)
B. The library is the home for documents: a rule in every provider's instructions, 'paper' defined, the old tool alias described as what it is (#68, #70, #71)
C. The local library is on by default for a profile that never decided otherwise, and a disconnect states its reason to the person and the agent (#72)
D. A pointer to the working folder's own project notes (#73)
E. The issues rewritten and closed with measured facts; C091's composer changes ride in the same chain and nightly
acceptance: A Barkdown run carries only Barkdown's servers: no claude.ai connector, no sign-in notice, a stable tool set
A profile stored as empty and off gets its local library by default; asked for a paper, a real agent creates it there with create_document
When there is no library the context says why
A chat with a working folder is pointed at that folder's project notes
Every issue is closed or rewritten with the measured facts; delivered in a nightly from a green chain
nextAction: Picture cycle, chain and nightly (they also deliver C091's composer changes); close the issues with the evidence; restart the owner's app so their profile picks up its library.
truthReview: 2026-10-04. Measured with the Agent SDK on the owner's login (Claude Code 2.1.289, Opus 5.5): a one-turn run costs about 16.7K input tokens with no MCP server at all, so that floor is Claude Code's own prompt and built-in tools; the 36K the issue claimed is two turns added together. With the claude.ai connectors present the second turn was 19.7K against 16.8K without: the connectors cost about 2.9K a turn (their tools are already deferred behind tool search; the cost is Claude Docs' instructions, the tool names and the sign-in notice), not 15 to 18K. settingSources: [] did not keep the connectors out as C089 F2 believed: all four were listed; strictMcpConfig: true does. In the real app a profile stored as empty and off now starts its local library (probe: connected), one deliberately turned off stays off and says so (probe: reason 'turned off in Settings › Barkpark'), and a real Claude run asked for a paper used create_document, opened it beside the chat, and answered NONE when asked for claude.ai tools (tests/agent-library.live.mjs, four checks). The app's test chain passes apart from the load-sensitive profile tour's website wait, which passes alone. Not done: the owner's own profile has not been restarted on this build; Codex and the API loop got the same library rule but no real run; the under-10K target of #67 is not reachable while Claude Code's own prompt is 16.7K.
screenshotReview: No renderer change; the real-agent run's frame shows the created paper beside the chat. Status shots and the visual run follow the implementation commit.

remaining: The owner's app restarted on this build
